verdict.rationale: ClickHouse publishes a pricing page describing usage-based billing, with compute and storage metered separately. It also offers autoscaling limits to prevent unexpected bills, which supports bill predictability. However, the evidence shows no actual per-unit rates and says nothing about traffic or egress pricing. Missing for 10: published per-unit price figures for compute and storage, data transfer/egress pricing, a cost calculator or estimator, independent corroboration that bills can be predicted in advance.

support.subject: As a founder, published per-unit pricing for compute, storage, and traffic lets me predict my bill before committing

citations.quote: Usage-based pricing: pay only for the compute and storage you use, scaled separately and down to zero when idle.
Set compute autoscaling limits to prevent runaway queries from unexpected bills
We automatically scale unused resources down to zero so that you don't pay for idle services
